'''Tank/landing ports''' were access tunnels to the city of [[Pavillion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. "Airbreathers," as the [[Iskalonian]]s called them, could use these ports to transport themselves from the landing pads on the surface to the self-contained city on the ocean floor.
